title: ROTH IRA: BEST DEAL IN PERSONAL FINANCE

concepts.title: Tax-Free Growth
concepts.body: You put in money you've already paid taxes on. It grows for decades, and you never owe a penny of tax on the growth. Not on the way in. Not on the way out.

concepts.title: The Catch
concepts.body: But there's a cap. Seven thousand dollars a year — that's the limit for 2024. And it's earned income only — you can't deposit gifted money or returns from other investments.

visual_spec.callout_text: Plus an income floor: you can only contribute what you earned this year. No 1099 income, no Roth contribution. Side gigs, salary, and self-employment count.

concepts.title: The Payoff
concepts.body: Max out your Roth for thirty years at seven percent. You retire with over a million dollars — tax free. That's the compounding engine no taxable account can match.

concepts.title: Set It And Forget It
concepts.body: Skip the trading apps. Open a Vanguard. Fund it with VOO — the S and P 500 at 0.03 percent expense. Set it on autopilot. Don't touch it till fifty nine and a half.

sources_footer: Sourced from IRS Pub 590-A, Vanguard, S&P 500 1928-2025.
